title: GTA Online Event Week: Halloween Event Continues (October 15th-21st){
description: RockstarINTEL reports that GTA Online's Halloween Event Week runs from October 15 to 21, extending the month-long Halloween event with fresh spooky missions, new rewards, and updated bonuses.
youtubeTitle: UPDATE: GTA Online Halloween Event Week Oct 15-21 – New Missions & Bonuses
socialHook: Update: GTA Online’s Halloween Event Week returns October 15‑21 with fresh spooky missions and a $400,000 bonus.

sections.heading: Event Schedule and Dates
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL announces that the Halloween Event Week in GTA Online will run from October 15 through October 21, 2026, extending the ongoing month‑long Halloween celebration introduced earlier in the month.
During this week, players can expect new and returning spooky missions, updated rewards, and rotating content across the game world, as detailed by the RockstarINTEL report.

sections.heading: Rewards and Bonuses
paragraphs: Completing the Kortz Center Heist without dying during this event week grants an additional GTA$400,000, resetting the first‑completion bonus and providing a substantial payout for skilled players, according to RockstarINTEL.

The FIB Priority File this week is The Brute Force File, which awards double payouts, and the Casino’s lucky wheel offers GTA+ members two daily spins for a chance to win the Grotti LSCM Cheetah Classic.

sections.heading: Additional Content and Vehicles
paragraphs: This week’s GTA Online Premium Test Ride vehicle is the Maibatsu MonstroCiti, available for PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC Enhanced players, while the Test Track features the Declasse Vamos, Dewbauchee Seven‑70, and Ocelot Locust, as reported by RockstarINTEL.

Car dealerships in Rockford Hills showcase the Dewbauchee Rapid GT X and Übermacht Sentinel XS4, and Simeon’s Auto Shop offers five vehicles for test drives, including the Albany Brigham, Albany Fränken Stange, Albany Lurcher, Declasse Tornado Rat Rod, and LCC Sanctus, expanding player options during the event.
